token_supervision: Rebuild token labels from character regions using the chosen tokenizer; mask special/padding tokens.
source: Existing 2,000 pre-2022 proceedings papers; only non-targeted extractable body paragraphs.
training_filter: split=train and development_exposed=false and clean_prose=true and text_appears_in_multiple_splits=false; deduplicate normalized text within training. Retain flagged prose separately for robustness.
evaluation_filter: Use frozen suite.jsonl for evaluation; it additionally removes training/validation text overlaps and development-exposed test papers. Do not mine its failures for training.
